title: Finish removing stamp duty on commercial and industrial property
action: Complete the move from stamp duty to an annual land tax on commercial and industrial property: in the ACT, remove the remaining duty on properties above the threshold; in Victoria, keep the transition to the annual property tax on schedule.
why: Duty on business property discourages firms from moving to better premises and from selling land to those who would use it more productively. An annual land tax raises revenue without that drag.

evidence.source: Australia's Future Tax System: Report to the Treasurer, Part One (Henry review)
evidence.quote: eliminating stamp duties on commercial and industrial properties in return for a broad land tax on those properties

evidence.source: Shifting the Dial: 5 Year Productivity Review
evidence.quote: State and Territory Governments should move from stamp duties on residential and commercial properties to a broad-based land tax on the unimproved value of land.

precedents.what: Phased out stamp duty on non-residential property transfers by 2018.

progress.what: South Australia has abolished it; the ACT and Victoria are part way.
